objects.description: [Bisonal](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0268) has used rundll32.exe to execute as part of the Registry Run key it adds: HKEY_CURRENT_USER \Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run\”vert” = “rundll32.exe c:\windows\temp\pvcu.dll , Qszdez”.(Citation: Unit 42 Bisonal July 2018)
objects.description_fa: [Bisonal](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0268) از rundll32.exe برای اجرای به عنوان بخشی از کلید Run Registry که اضافه می‌کند استفاده کرده است: HKEY_CURRENT_USER \Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run\”vert” = “rundll32.exe c:\windows\temp\pvcu.dll , Qszdez”.(Citation: Unit 42 Bisonal July 2018)
